spans.s:
Nicula
poet; said to be a sobriquet for writing the verse.
saMsargajA doSaguNA bhavantItyetanmRSA yena jalAzrayo'p. | sthitvAnukUlaM niculazcalantamAtmAnamArakSati sindhuvegAt || See Dakṣiṇāvarta's C. on Meghadūta, v. 14.

Nicula
poet; contemporary of Kālidāsa according to Dakṣiṇāvartanātha an. Mallinātha who read a. reference to him in Meghadūta, v. 14 (‘sarasaniculAt’).

Nicula
claims to be a friend of Kālidāsa an. protege of Bhoja ! prob. later than Dakṣiṇāvartanātha.
--C. Taralā on Nānārthaśabdaratna ascribed to Kālidāsa. Adyar D.
